kind: TTPO-inspired SDXL adaptation, NOT exact FLUX paper reproduction
preference: MUSIQ only, framewise argmax/argmin; fixed before generation; no target access
input: same 9 validation videos as prior pilot
scheduler: EulerDiscrete epsilon, use scheduler predicted original sample and stop-gradient denoiser
frequency: Gaussian real-space low/high decomposition via FFT, normalized Nyquist cutoff .9
stage: first30% structure only; middle60% both; final10% preference only; normalized active steps (adaptation)
guidance: subtract g * gradient of mean losses from scheduler prev_sample; no gradient normalization
postprocessing: native plus fixed .25 VAE-roundtrip-subtracted residual for EVERY arm
primary_comparison: pref1000 vs plain; pref100 is prespecified sensitivity; report both without test selection
target_usage: evaluation only after all outputs saved
limitations: single NR-IQA; cached128 candidate re-encoding; framewise editing; exploratory small validation set
